root_cause_criterion.criterion: Before loop_restoration_alloc() sizes lr_sync, foreach_rest_unit_in_planes_mt() must compute num_rows_lr large enough to cover the active chroma plane's actual vertical restoration-unit count, rather than leaving num_rows_lr smaller than cm->rst_info[1].vert_units_per_tile.
root_cause_criterion.description: On the vulnerable path with luma restoration disabled, foreach_rest_unit_in_planes_mt() keeps using the sequence superblock size across every plane, so num_rows_lr stays at 1 even though the active chroma plane later contributes 2 restoration rows. The fixed image raises num_rows_lr to the chroma plane's true row count before allocation.

nodes.state: The crash write at lr_job_queue[lr_job_counter[i & 1]].lr_unit_row = i executes with lr_job_counter[i & 1] already at the first index that is not covered by the allocated lr_sync->rows * num_planes capacity.

loop_restoration_alloc() allocates lr_sync->job_queue from num_rows_lr * num_planes, preserving the row count computed in foreach_rest_unit_in_planes_mt() as the queue capacity later reused at the sink.

edges.relation: The num_rows_lr computed in foreach_rest_unit_in_planes_mt() is passed unchanged into loop_restoration_alloc() and becomes the row count that sizes lr_sync->job_queue and cur_sb_col.
The slot count allocated for lr_sync->job_queue in loop_restoration_alloc() is the same capacity later compared against the enqueue-time lr_job_counter index at the sink store.
